definition: Rita Cucchiara (born 13 March 1965) is an Italian computer engineer, academic, and researcher in the field of computer vision and artificial intelligence.
details: She has been appointed Rector of the University of Modena and Reggio Emilia (UNIMORE) starting from 1 November 2025, succeeding Carlo Adolfo Porro. She is currently Full Professor of Computer Engineering at UNIMORE, where she directed the AImageLab and the Interdepartmental Research Center AI Research and Innovation (AIRI).

explainer.lead: Rita Cucchiara is an Academic and Rector (born 13 March 1965). Her work spans informatics, computer architecture, computer vision and artificial intelligence.

contributions.name: She is the author of over 600 scientific papers, with more than 33,000 citations and an h-index of 77, according to Google Scholar (2025).
She has coordinated or contributed to numerous European and national research projects, including HUMAN-E-AI, ELSA, ELIAS, ELLiOT, FIT4MedRob, and EcoSistER (PNRR).

timeline.what: She graduated with honors in Electronic Engineering from the University of Bologna in 1989 and earned her Ph.D. in Electronic and Computer Engineering in 1993 from the same university.
Cucchiara began her academic career as a researcher at the University of Ferrara (1993-1998).
She later joined the University of Modena and Reggio Emilia, where she became Associate Professor and, since 2005, Full Professor of Computer Engineering.
